subject: Problems with DSM analysis - analysis halted due to missing ddf

messages.author: 3cc57783657c133b
messages.subject: Problems with DSM analysis - analysis halted due to missing ddf
parts:
Dear colleagues,

I have problems with DSM analysis and I did not find a similar case =
discussed here in the mailing list. =20
The execution of the analysis is halted when data object "ddf.1" or =
"ddf.any number" (depending which of the previous CDS, MCDS or MRDS =
analyses I have indicated as the fitted detection probability function) =
is not found. It seems that Distance has not written this data to the R =
analysis folder. Any ideas what could be the problem and what can I do =
to fix this?=20
(BTW, MRDS analyses, which also use R, run fine. So there should be no =
problem with R installation).
